title: The Crown
summary: Build the Crown's economy and its army: gold from the Farm, powder from the Mill, Musketeers, a wall on the ramp and a cannon. Then hold the high ground.
learn: The Powder Mill (powder); soil and saltpetre run out
Walls and a gate on the ramp

say: Welcome to the Crown, commander. That is your Town Hall, and beside it its Farm.
Labourers hoe the Farm. Each harvest brings in gold.

say.pc: Train a Labourer: press LABOURER on the card, or its key.
say.phone: Train a Labourer: tap LABOURER on the card.

say: A full Farm ripens about every forty seconds.
Mind the Soil on your hall: the land runs out in time. Then you must build a new Town Hall on fresh ground.
Men need room. A Cottage gives supply.

say.pc: Select a Labourer, press BUILD (B), pick the COTTAGE and click where it goes.
say.phone: Select a Labourer, tap BUILD, pick the COTTAGE and tap where it goes.

say: Musketeers need black powder for their shots. Build a Powder Mill near the hall: each hall allows one.
It grinds the hall's saltpetre into powder. Saltpetre runs out too.

say.pc: Now put Labourers to work in it: select some and right-click the Mill.
say.phone: Now put Labourers to work in it: select some and tap the Mill.

steps.task: Put 2 Labourers in the Powder Mill.

say: Now a Barracks. It needs the Cottage you built. Here is some gold from the treasury.
Select the Barracks and train three Musketeers. Each costs gold and ten powder.
Your base sits on high ground, and the ramp is the only way up.
Gates open for your side only.

say.pc: Close it: select a Labourer, BUILD, PALISADE, and drag across the top of the ramp. Then place a GATE in the line.
say.phone: Close it: select a Labourer, tap BUILD, PALISADE, and drag across the top of the ramp. Then place a GATE in the line.

steps.task: Wall the top of the ramp, with a gate in it.

say: Now the guns. Build a Foundry: it needs the Barracks.
Cannons are drawn by horses. Your Horse Breeder trains them, and one click at the Foundry pays for both.
Train a Field Cannon. Round shot reaches farther than anything.
Hold the high ground. Men below a cliff cannot see up onto it, but you can shoot down.
steps.task: Put 3 Musketeers on the ridge above the ramp.

say: Raiders at the foot of the ramp! Let them come to your wall.
That is the Crown's way: a strong economy, a wall on the ramp, and shot from the high ground.
Now try it in a practice game against the computer.

you.text: You built the Crown's economy, walled your ramp, trained Musketeers and a cannon, and held the high ground.
